sequence.name: Connected Cozy and Shared Automated Play
Recovery, Safety, Acceptance and Implementation Handoff

authority_rules: AutoGM and CozyMode are play experiences, not permanent account roles.
APW-01 universal-user and Personal/Campaign/Session context authority is controlling for APM.
AutoGM automation receives only explicitly delegated governed operations; optional AI does not inherit unrestricted GM authority.
Mechanical legality and canonical mutation remain owned by deterministic/domain-governed rules and authority checks.
Automated play reuses ordinary Campaign/Action/Event/persistence/provenance/recovery architecture rather than forking state.
Connected Cozy begins with invited/known participants; public matchmaking is outside initial scope.
non_goals: No unlimited open-ended autonomous campaign requirement for initial APM.
No public stranger matchmaking in initial APM.
No release, deployment, paid-provider, production-credential, public-marketplace or canonical-promotion authority.
No CCTI-12-T04 resumption before September 2026 without explicit owner override.
